home.key_elements: Use 'Manrope' for headings. Hero should feel like a sanctuary. Trust strip must be prominent.

services.layout: Grid of cards (Bento-lite). Each service card needs an icon and a 'Learn More' link.

about_saloni.layout: Split layout: Image on left, Bio on right. Use 'Playfair Display' for quotes.

ai_safety.layout: Single column text with 'Shield' iconography. Transparent background with subtle mesh gradient.

crisis.layout: Red/Rose accented border. Clear, large text. Direct phone numbers.

universal_guidelines: Use 'Manrope' for Headings and 'Inter' for Body text.
Primary Color is Deep Teal (#0F766E). Use it for primary actions.
Background is Warm Off-White (#FDFCF8). Avoid pure white for large backgrounds.
Use 2x-3x padding for a premium feel.
All interactive elements must have a hover state (opacity change or slight lift).
Crisis information must be distinct but not panic-inducing.
AI transparency is mandatory - clearly label AI features.
Mobile-first responsive design is critical for the India market.
Do not use 'transition: all'. Animate specific properties.
Ensure all interactive elements have 'data-testid' attributes.
